About the job
Description

We are transforming commercial underwriting & claims processing with AI-assisted workflows that enable disciplined responsiveness for decision making at scale — driving consistency, efficiency, and profitability across the business in GRS. The Global AI Products & Transformation Team sits within the Data Science Solutions department in Global Risk Solutions (GRS) and is responsible for building and scaling those AI-enabled automation products across all segments of the commercial business. In this role, you will lead a small team of data scientists while remaining hands-on technically.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and evaluate GenAI solutions and agentic workflow automation systems
Build evaluation metrics and tools to assess GenAI systems’ performance, reliability, and safety
Recruit, manage and develop a team of data scientists and analysts

Qualifications & Skills

Proven expertise in building agentic AI systems using LangChain/LangGraph for underwriting automation
Strong MLOps expertise across the complete data science lifecycle using MLFlow3/Databricks

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location.

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer.
